subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students asked why a mirror needed decoration on the back.”?
options: The guide said ancient children played, learned, and made imperfect things too.
The guide said objects can be practical and symbolic at the same time.
The guide said, "Because justice improves only when people remember where it failed."
The guide said astronomy began not only with instruments, but with patient watching.
